scope: Source-bound terminology/impact note for a future G02 contract; no runtime policy change

findings.fact: Half-metre cells use512u size and256u center offset; existing center conversion functions directly derive a world position from a cell ID.

Existing lattice-position admission checks minimum/maximum center bounds and modulus against the256u offset. A root-preserving offset family must keep root position admission distinct from footprint anchor bounds.

PATH-R02 exact-start routing already uses anchor terminology for macro/cache compatibility and publishes actual start paths. Its descriptor/request anchor fields are not an available profile-footprint anchor field to repurpose silently.

consequence: The future contract must give separate names and semantics to physical footprint anchor, root-containing cell, exact path start and existing macro/cache anchor; preserve PATH-R02 exact-start behavior and saved route versioning.
